# API configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-config-reference.py from Terrakube origin/main. Do not edit by hand. -->

Environment variables of the Terrakube **API**. See [Configuration Reference](README.md) for how to set them. An empty default means the variable has no default: either it is optional or it must be provided.

### LIQUIBASE SETUP

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DatasourceSchema` | `public` | Sets `spring.liquibase.default-schema`. |

### QUARTZ SETUP

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

### WEBHOOK DELIVERY

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `WebhookDispatchExecutorCorePoolSize` | `10` | Dispatch pool is bounded so a burst of shared-webhook deliveries (e.g. a force-push touching a repo with many workspaces) can't spawn unbounded threads competing for the app's DB connection pool or the VCS provider's API rate limit. |
| `WebhookDispatchExecutorMaxPoolSize` | `20` | Sets `io.terrakube.webhook.dispatch.executor.maxPoolSize`. |
| `WebhookDispatchExecutorQueueCapacity` | `200` | Sets `io.terrakube.webhook.dispatch.executor.queueCapacity`. |
| `WebhookPollerBatchSize` | `200` | Sets `io.terrakube.webhook.poller.batchSize`. |
| `WebhookPollerStuckProcessingThresholdMinutes` | `5` | Sets `io.terrakube.webhook.poller.stuckProcessingThresholdMinutes`. |
| `WebhookDeliveryRetentionDays` | `30` | Sets `io.terrakube.webhook.delivery.retentionDays`. |
| `WebhookWorkspaceFanoutConcurrency` | `4` | Bounds how many workspaces on one shared webhook are processed concurrently - see WorkspaceFanoutExecutorConfig. |
| `WebhookWorkspaceFanoutQueueCapacity` | `200` | Sets `io.terrakube.webhook.workspace-fanout.queue-capacity`. |
| `WebhookDispatchConnectTimeoutSeconds` | `5` | Pooled HTTP client for GitHub/GitLab/Azure DevOps API calls (WebhookHttpClientConfig) - replaces a fresh RestTemplate + TCP/TLS handshake per call. |
| `WebhookDispatchResponseTimeoutSeconds` | `30` | Sets `io.terrakube.webhook.dispatch.http.responseTimeoutSeconds`. |
| `WebhookDispatchConnectionRequestTimeoutSeconds` | `2` | Sets `io.terrakube.webhook.dispatch.http.connectionRequestTimeoutSeconds`. |

### EPHEMERAL EXECUTOR CONFIG

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ExecutorEphemeralNamespace` | `terrakube` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.ephemeral.namespace`. |
| `ExecutorEphemeralImage` | `azbuilder/executor:2.34.0` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.ephemeral.image`. |
| `ExecutorEphemeralSecret` | `terrakube-executor-secrets` | Comma-separated list for multiple secrets: e.g. "secret-one,secret-two" |
| `ExecutorEphemeralEmptyDirSecret` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.ephemeral.emptyDirSecret`. |
| `ExecutorEphemeralInitSecretImage` | `busybox:1.37.0` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.ephemeral.initSecretImage`. |
| `ExecutorEphemeralActiveDeadlineSeconds` |  | Maximum seconds a job's pod may run before Kubernetes terminates it as failed; unset means no deadline (unbounded). |
| `ExecutorEphemeralBackoffLimit` |  | Number of retries before a job is marked failed; unset means Kubernetes' own default (6). Set to 0 for at-most-once execution. |
| `ExecutorEphemeralTerminationGracePeriodSeconds` | `60` | Seconds the pod gets to shut down cleanly after SIGTERM before Kubernetes SIGKILLs it; unset means 60. |
| `ExecutorEphemeralTtlSecondsAfterFinished` | `30` | Seconds after completion before the job is automatically deleted; unset means 30. |
| `ExecutorReplicas` | `1` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.replicas`. |

### AWS Storage

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AwsStorageAccessKey` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.accessKey`. |
| `AwsStorageSecretKey` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.secretKey`. |
| `AwsStorageBucketName` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.bucketName`. |
| `AwsStorageRegion` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.region`. |
| `AwsEndpoint` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.endpoint`. |
| `AwsEnableRoleAuth` | `false` | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.enableRoleAuthentication`. |
| `AwsEndpointRegion` | `auto` | S3-compatible backends (Qumulo, MinIO, ...) that need a real signing region or no chunked/checksum support |
| `AwsPathStyleAccess` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.pathStyleAccessEnabled`. |
| `AwsChunkedEncodingEnabled` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.chunkedEncodingEnabled`. |
| `AwsChecksumValidationEnabled` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.checksumValidationEnabled`. |
| `StorageApiCallTimeoutSeconds` | `10` | Storage read resilience - a hung object read fails within apiCallTimeout instead of the SDK's multi-minute default retry ladder. Step-log objects are KB-sized; sub-second latency is normal. |
| `StorageApiCallAttemptTimeoutSeconds` | `3` | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.apiCallAttemptTimeoutSeconds`. |
| `StorageMaxRetryAttempts` | `2` | Sets `io.terrakube.storage.aws.maxRetryAttempts`. |
| `ContextCacheTtl` | `30s` | /context/v1 read path: short per-pod cache + single-flight coalescing of concurrent misses, plus an overall read budget applied on top of the shared S3 client timeouts above. |
| `ContextCacheMaxEntries` | `500` | Sets `io.terrakube.context.cache-max-entries`. |
| `ContextReadTimeout` | `8s` | Sets `io.terrakube.context.read-timeout`. |
| `ContextRetryAfterSeconds` | `5` | Sets `io.terrakube.context.retry-after-seconds`. |
| `ContextReadWorkers` | `4` | Sets `io.terrakube.context.read-workers`. |
| `ContextReadQueueCapacity` | `64` | Sets `io.terrakube.context.read-queue-capacity`. |

### LOGS

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LogsCacheMaxWeightBytes` | `268435456` | Completed-step logs are immutable - cache them so many concurrent viewers plus polling collapse to a single storage read. Objects larger than cacheable-max-object-bytes stream through uncached. |
| `LogsCacheTtl` | `10m` | Sets `io.terrakube.logs.cache-ttl`. |
| `LogsCacheableMaxObjectBytes` | `1048576` | Sets `io.terrakube.logs.cacheable-max-object-bytes`. |
| `LogsLiveTailRecords` | `5000` | Running-step plain GET returns at most this many trailing lines from the Redis stream, so it never scans the whole (potentially huge) stream from the start. |
| `LogsSseMaxConnections` | `1500` | Step-log SSE: one Redis reader per job fans out to all its viewers. Per-pod connection cap returns 503 + Retry-After beyond the limit; a stream is closed after sse-max-stream-duration and the client reconnects with Last-Event-ID. |
| `LogsSseJobIdleTimeout` | `2s` | Sets `io.terrakube.logs.sse-job-idle-timeout`. |
| `LogsSseMaxStreamDuration` | `30m` | Sets `io.terrakube.logs.sse-max-stream-duration`. |
| `LogsJobStatusCacheTtl` | `2s` | Sets `io.terrakube.logs.job-status-cache-ttl`. |
| `LogsRedisMaxLen` | `200000` | Cap on a job's live-log Redis stream when logs are ingested via the API (/logs endpoint). |
| `LogsAppendMaxBytes` | `4194304` | Sets `io.terrakube.logs.append-max-bytes`. |
| `LogsAppendLineMaxBytes` | `65536` | Sets `io.terrakube.logs.append-line-max-bytes`. |
| `LogsStreamCleanupCron` | `0 */10 * * * ?` | Housekeeping sweep that reclaims the {jobId} and {jobId}-context Redis streams once a job has been terminal for grace-period-minutes; only jobs terminal within the trailing lookback window are scanned. |
| `LogsStreamCleanupGracePeriodMinutes` | `30` | Sets `io.terrakube.logs.stream-cleanup.grace-period-minutes`. |
| `LogsStreamCleanupLookbackHours` | `24` | Sets `io.terrakube.logs.stream-cleanup.lookback-hours`. |

### MODULE VERSION REFRESH

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ModuleRefreshInterval` | `300` | How often the Quartz job re-reads the Git tags of one module. Lower it to shorten the delay between a module release and the version showing up in the registry. |

### ZERO-PENDING JOB RECONCILIATION

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SchedulerReconciliationSweepEnabled` | `true` | Repairs jobs that are stuck non-terminal with no remaining executable step (they would otherwise block the shared executor FIFO queue forever). See the design doc dated 2026-09-02. |
| `SchedulerReconciliationAutoRemediate` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.api.scheduler.reconciliation.auto-remediate`. |
| `SchedulerReconciliationAdmissionGuardEnabled` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.api.scheduler.reconciliation.admission-guard-enabled`. |
| `SchedulerReconciliationAnomalyGraceSeconds` | `300` | Sets `io.terrakube.api.scheduler.reconciliation.anomaly-grace-seconds`. |

### DISPATCH RETRY

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SchedulerDispatchRetryEnabled` | `true` | Bounded retry/backoff for pre-submission dispatch failures (currently: VCS access-token acquisition) so a provider outage/misconfiguration fails the job instead of retrying forever and blocking the shared FIFO queue across workspaces. |
| `SchedulerDispatchRetryMaxAttempts` | `8` | Sets `io.terrakube.api.scheduler.dispatch-retry.max-attempts`. |
| `SchedulerDispatchRetryMaxElapsedMinutes` | `60` | Sets `io.terrakube.api.scheduler.dispatch-retry.max-elapsed-minutes`. |
| `SchedulerDispatchRetryInitialBackoffSeconds` | `15` | Sets `io.terrakube.api.scheduler.dispatch-retry.initial-backoff-seconds`. |
| `SchedulerDispatchRetryMaxBackoffSeconds` | `900` | Sets `io.terrakube.api.scheduler.dispatch-retry.max-backoff-seconds`. |
| `SchedulerDispatchRetryAdmissionDeferralEnabled` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.api.scheduler.dispatch-retry.admission-deferral-enabled`. |
